crossRefs.note: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said, “Blessed are you who are poor, God’s Kingdom is yours.
Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay…
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you…
Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the…
My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:

translations.web: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
translations.bsb: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
translations.kjv: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
translations.asv: I am small and despised; Yet do I not forget thy precepts.
